eligibility_text: Any person with a certified disability, assessed by a state Medical Board.
benefits: A single national ID and disability certificate (replacing multiple state-issued paper certificates) that is the standard proof of eligibility most other disability-linked schemes (ADIP, reservations, travel concessions, tax benefits) check against.
source_note: Foundational identity scheme for the disability category — worth asking about early, similar to e-Shram for gig workers.
